# mdbtools / fuzz_mdb

mdbtools's own fuzz target `fuzz_mdb` ([source](source/fuzz_mdb.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over mdbtools 1.0.1 (mdbtools/mdbtools at b81b1c92).

mdb_open_buffer on the input; reads the table catalog, then for each table reads the columns, rewinds and fetches every row; nothing checked.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against mdbtools 1.0.1 at commit b81b1c92.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch mdbtools` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_mdb.plain` | 495,400 | `39497940092e4cb9d75827ffd6870fb0b2672e6d20328d967bb1b133f48fc0b0` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_mdb.ubsan` | 504,208 | `c56271e5c5f00f4b617b8790d97b1d593127bd0773ff5dd82ab32c90457fbecd` |
| asan | `fuzz_mdb.asan` | 1,105,096 | `7655ff60980e22f13a3fe4fa421e7852b12b2cc0537d94cfbc378df49b0aa687` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_mdb.asan-ubsan` | 1,111,336 | `843c6380f477fbdbd17cb286ff008fbb36bc6c216727f8714d935630bc244a3b` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libglib-2.0.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libglib-2.0.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libglib-2.0.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libglib-2.0.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
